cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know. Could you stay for the part that isn't the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit with me for nine. I don't want the last thing we fixed tonight to be the sink.

mechanism: A treats its partner conflict repair as a pupil conversation exercise and keeps them present beyond the completed cleanup.
confusable: Unlike demanding apology wording alone, A wants continued presence until their connection feels repaired.
comparison: Cleanup finished/last bus versus packed departure/paid dinner.
seedUse: D74 dishes/bus/nine minutes; S05 corrective listening exercise used to hold emotional contact.
